other_conditions: Must be located in census villages, semi‑urban or urban areas within 0‑10 km (crow‑fly) from the International Boundary in the listed border districts
Strategic villages/towns identified by Border Guarding Forces receive the highest priority
Program may extend to areas up to 10‑20/30/40/50 km after saturation of the 0‑10 km zone
benefits_summary: Infrastructure development in border areas covering roads, bridges, health, education, agriculture, water supply, sports, social sector facilities and related projects.
